title: Special Order for Lloyd's Auto & Towing Services, LLC, ex parte. — Lloyd’s Auto & Towing Services, LLC, ex parte. In re: Request for cancellation of LPSC No. 7281-A. THEREFORE, IT IS ORDERED LPSC No. 7281-A hereby is, cancelled.
